samples.question: One red cap marks the start of one connected navy route and a green cap marks its end. Follow the route from red to green. It has 32 successive teeth, each with an apex between two baseline joins. Unroll the route in traversal order. For every tooth write # when its apex is above its two joins and . when it is below. Place the 32 marks row-major into a 4-row by 8-column bitmap and compare it with A) LOOP = 11110000/10011001/10011001/11110000 or B) LACE = 00001111/01100110/01100110/00001111. If the distances tie, choose A; tie cases are quarantined. Which symbol appears? Answer A or B. Ignore the caps and background.
